title: Strict Minkowski Inequality: Equality iff Proportional

problemStatement.plain: In a real inner product space, equality in the triangle inequality holds iff the vectors are non-negatively proportional.

currentState.focus: Main iff theorem proved modulo 2 algebra helpers

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Created CauchySchwarzIntegralOQ02OQ01.lean. Main theorem norm_add_eq_iff_proportional proved modulo 2 helpers. Forward: squaring + linarith gives C-S equality. Backward: C-S equality + nlinarith gives squared equality, then factoring gives equality. 2 sorries in inner product algebra helpers.
builtItems: inner_eq_of_proportional: proportionality → C-S equality (sorry — needs inner_smul_right + star simplification)

insights: The forward direction reduces to: ‖f+g‖² = (‖f‖+‖g‖)² → ⟪f,g⟫ = ‖f‖‖g‖ via linarith on norm_add_sq_real
The backward direction: C-S equality → squared equality via nlinarith, then (a-b)(a+b)=0 factoring
